title: Run API
description: Message bodies of ploegd's run API — the executor contract surface (docs/contracts/executor.md). Endpoints: POST /api/v1/claim, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/renew, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/checkpoint, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/outcome, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential (ADR-0086: a writing Run refreshes an expiring push credential; 409 when the deployment mints none), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/transcript (ADR-0090: a batch of the Run's transcript; 404 when PLOEG_RUN_TRANSCRIPTS is off), POST and GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session, POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential and POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/report (ADR-0084; all answer 404 unless PLOEG_CLAUDE_ENVIRONMENTS is true), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session and POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential (ADR-0084; both answer 404 unless PLOEG_CLAUDE_ENVIRONMENTS is true). GET /api/v1/queue/depth and its queueDepthResponse were removed on 2026-09-23 because nothing consumed them; executors read the scale signal by SQL (docs/contracts/executor.md).

role.description: claim only this Role's pending Run within the team (run-multi-agent-shifts). Absent = the pre-Shift claim, unchanged.

harness.description: The worker's harness (PLOEG_HARNESS), such as openhands, acp, exec, claude-code or claude-environment. ploegd records it on the claimed Run (ADR-0091). Absent leaves it unknown.

harnessProfile.description: The harness's agent profile, such as opencode, qwen-code or custom for the acp harness. ploegd records it on the claimed Run (ADR-0091). Absent when the harness has none.

claimResponse.description: HTTP 200 body; HTTP 204 = no claimable work (empty-handed convention, exit 0), which also covers an exhausted Shift budget — retrying cannot fix running out of money, so the sweeper parks the item instead.

runToken.description: Run identifier used by renew/checkpoint/outcome routes; managed mode also requires the scoped control capability and worker identity described in worker-control.md

shift.description: the Shift this Run belongs to; absent on a pre-Shift claim

writes.description: true = this Run holds the Shift's Lease and may push; false = a reader, which takes no Lease (ADR-0010)

branch.description: the Shift's branch, derived server-side at Shift open; absent on a pre-Shift claim, where the worker derives it

authorized.description: USD ceiling the run's LLM credential must be minted at: min(roleCap, poolRemaining) (ADR-0012). Absent or 0 = use the worker's env budget.

forgeToken.description: Push credential for this run. Absent = use the worker's env credential. Never logged, never audited, never in a Task Spec (R8).

forgeTokenPerRun.description: True when forgeToken was minted for this run alone and is revoked when it settles (ADR-0013 tier 2); false or absent when it is the deployment's shared token, which the Static broker returns in the same field.

forgeTokenExpiresAt.description: When the forge ends forgeToken by itself; a GitHub App installation token lasts one hour (ADR-0086). Absent = the token lives until it is revoked. The worker refreshes it before then through POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential.

planner.description: True when the team's plan marks this Role as a planner (ADR-0031): the worker composes the planner prompt, which asks for createdWorkItems instead of code. Absent = not a planner.

preAuthor.description: True for a reading Run when no writing Run precedes its Round in the Shift, so the Shift's branch may not exist yet. Only then does the worker review the base branch when that branch is absent; otherwise an absent branch ends the Run stuck. Absent = false.

context.description: The files people attached to the Work Item before this Run was claimed, oldest first (proposed, context bundles proof of concept). References only: the worker downloads each from GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/context/{id} with the Run's capability and verifies sha256 and bytes before the harness starts. Absent = none.

contextRef.description: One context item a claim hands a Run (proposed, context bundles proof of concept).

phase.description: while_steering = a Run of the Work Item had already started when the person attached it

forgeCredentialResponse.description: Response of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential: a new push credential for the Run's own repository. ploegd revokes the one it replaces. Never logged (R8).

renewResponse.description: HTTP 200 body; HTTP 404 = lease no longer ours, cancel the run.

claudeSessionRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session: the self-hosted Claude session the worker dispatched for this Run (ADR-0084). HTTP 204 = recorded, also when the same binding is recorded again; 409 = the Run or the session is already bound to another.

sessionId.description: Either prefix names the same session.

claudeForgeCredentialResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential, authenticated with the session's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ACCESS_TOKEN as a bearer token. A push credential minted for the session's writing Run and scoped to its repository; it replaces and revokes the Run's previous one. 401 = token refused; 403 = a reading Run; 404 = no running writing Run with a live Lease for the session; 409 = no per-run credential can be minted.

branch.description: The Shift's branch: the only branch the Run's Lease lets it push.

remote.description: HTTPS URL of the Run's repository; a runner pushes here, never to a remote a checkout's config names.

claudeSessionReportRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/report, authenticated like the forge-credential exchange: what a runner's post-session hook reports once the session ended. HTTP 204 = recorded; the first report wins and a repeat is a no-op. 404 = no running Run recorded the session.

exitReason.description: The runner's CLAUDE_RUNNER_EXIT_REASON: completed, failed or interrupted.

finalMessage.description: Claude's final message; it carries the Run's outcome JSON.

claudeSessionStateResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session: the session the worker recorded and, once reportedAt is present, the runner's report. 404 = the Run is not running or recorded no session.

transcriptRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/transcript (ADR-0090): a batch of the Run's transcript, at most 1 MiB. Entries are stored by seq, so a resent batch is ignored entry by entry. Accepted only while the Run is running. HTTP 200 with transcriptAppendResponse; 400 = a malformed batch; 404 = the Run is not running or the deployment records no transcripts (PLOEG_RUN_TRANSCRIPTS=off), after which the worker stops sending.

transcriptEntry.description: One transcript entry as the worker sends it; the operator API's transcriptEntry describes each field. ploegd clamps every field to its limit and redacts the text again before storing it. A missing at, or one more than five minutes ahead of ploegd, becomes the time ploegd received it.

accepted.description: Entries stored now; an entry stored before is not counted.

truncated.description: The transcript reached its limit; later entries are refused.

knowledgeResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/knowledge: what the Tenant's graphs hold for this Run's own scopes, which ploegd takes from its records and never from the request (ADR-0087, proposed). Carries no graph credential.

knowledgeNotes.description: The Work Item Notes of the Run's root Work Item, newest first. Written without review (ADR-0088, proposed).

status.description: off: this deployment writes no notes. unavailable: the graph did not answer; the Run goes ahead without notes.

commit.description: The notes graph commit the items were read at.

knowledgeConcepts.description: Reviewed concepts the Run may read: every Tenant-scoped concept, those of its Work Item's Client and those of its Work Target repository (ADR-0087, proposed). Absent when this deployment serves no knowledge graph.

status.description: unavailable: the graph did not answer; the Run goes ahead without it.

commit.description: The knowledge graph commit every item was read at.

path.description: The OKF concept path inside its scope.

document.description: The whole OKF document: frontmatter and markdown body.
